title: Episode 1 - Kya main hi chor hoon?
end_card:
पार्ट 2 कल!
दिवाली में 10 दिन बाकी

shots.visual: Early morning in the village square after the festival night. The big brass thali on the decorated table is empty except for crumbs. Bhola has just woken up under the banyan tree with laddoo crumbs and sticky syrup on his snout, paws and scarf. He stares at his sticky paws, then at the empty thali, in horror.
shots.camera: quick push-in on Bhola's horrified face, then a shot of his sticky paws

lines.speaker: bhola
lines.hi: लड्डू गायब... मेरे हाथ में चाशनी?! क्या मैं ही चोर हूँ?

shots.visual: Kallu the crow hops down onto Bhola's shoulder with a stolen laddoo hidden behind his wing, which the audience can see but Bhola cannot. Kallu whispers in Bhola's ear with a fake worried face, glancing around. Bhola trembles with huge scared eyes and nods quickly.
shots.camera: close two-shot on their faces, Kallu whispering, the hidden laddoo visible behind his wing

lines.speaker: kallu
lines.hi: तूने नींद में लड्डू खाए! समोसा दे, मैं सँभाल लूँगा!

shots.visual: Chikki walks confidently into the village square from the left, stops with her hands on her hips and stares sharply ahead at someone off-screen. Behind her tiny Chulbul the white rat scurries along carrying a huge notebook with a tiny gold paw-print sticker on its cover, trips over it and his cap slides over his eyes.
shots.camera: low angle shot of Chikki walking in, then the camera arcs right to reveal Chulbul tripping behind her

lines.speaker: chikki
lines.hi: रुको! मैं चिक्की! दिवाली से पहले चोर पकड़ूँगी!

lines.speaker: chulbul
lines.hi: और मैं सुपर सीक्रेट असिस्टेंट चुलबुल!

shots.visual: Cliffhanger. Chikki crouches by the empty brass thali with her magnifying glass and finds small three-toed prints in the dust next to huge paw prints. Chulbul squints at the prints hanging upside-down from the table edge. A single black feather drifts down onto Chikki's notebook. She slowly looks up toward the banyan tree, where Kallu the crow sits frozen with a nervous smile and a sweat drop.
shots.camera: top-down on the prints, then a slow tilt up from the feather to Kallu in the tree

lines.speaker: chikki
lines.hi: ये निशान भोला के नहीं... चोर कोई और है!
